hero.prompt: Replace the old graphite devices with two burgundy iPhone 18 Pro Max front and rear views. Match the model-reference camera plateau, burgundy unibody, Dynamic Island, and luminous folded burgundy wallpaper. Premium studio materials, transparent background, no text or plinth, generous margin for animation.
hero.motion: Continuous 360-degree CSS Y-axis rotation, 12 seconds per turn; reduced-motion support; no pause button
hero.geometry: Slim 12px metal body, separate photographic faces, raised camera plateau, continuous 360-degree rotation; reduced-motion and off-screen playback support.

texture.prompt: Photorealistic orthographic burgundy iPhone 18 Pro Max front/rear atlas. Fine-grain satin anodized aluminum, realistic optical glass, restrained wallpaper brightness and reflections, exact model-reference proportions. Transparent background, no perspective, no illustration or toy-like highlights.
